metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Mean off-diagonal cosine similarity of up to 2048 seeded sampled nonpadding item embeddings, mapped from [-1,1] to [0,1]. Higher indicates more aligned embedding directions; this does not directly measure recommendation diversity. Null means fewer than two sampled items or a nonfinite sampled embedding.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Training-only mean positive-minus-negative logit over nonpadding positions with finite margins. Null means no finite observations; not validation performance.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Training-only nearest-rank 10th percentile of finite positive-minus-negative logits at nonpadding positions. Null means no finite observations.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Training-only fraction of finite valid margins below zero. Null means no finite observations.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Training-only fraction of finite valid margins below eps=0.5. Null means no finite observations.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Training-only margin counts, finite/nonfinite observation counts and batches used. Item categories are unavailable, so category lists remain empty with an explicit availability flag. Counts of low or negative margins are null without finite observations. Simulator diversity and conformity traits are unobserved. Malformed loader batches raise explicit errors.
metric_definitions.diagnosis_elapsed_seconds: Measured wall time for this bounded diagnostic pass, including device synchronization.
